cases.input: Thread. Parent: "I could make her available when you are available. The library is being used as an election polling place but I think they still have space on the other side. Will you be available for two consecutive hours if our total is 10?" Tutor: "To clarify, you want to move one of the future hours and add it to tomorrow, rather than adding an additional hour overall? I can do two hours tomorrow. How does 2:00pm - 4:00pm at the library sound?" Parent: "Yes please add one of the future hours to tomorrow as well - if I need to add hours later on I can decide later on. Yes 2-4pm sounds good. Thank you"
